subject.name: AP Statistics
subject.designNotes: Topic codes, titles (shortened), unit class periods, MC unit and practice weights are from the 2027 CED (five units, Statistical Practices 1-4). Per-topic skills are the CED's suggested skills. Sub-keywords, kinds, requires and estLessons are original tutoring-sequence proposals. FRQ weighting is by question (4 FRQs at 12.5% each: Q1 Practices 1-2, Q2 Practices 3-4, Q3 inference, Q4 Practices 2-4), not by practice, so no frq skill weights are given. Topic order follows the CED.
